ModMetaData.name: Archinity - Drifters
ModMetaData.author: cjd72
ModMetaData.description:
Part of the Archinity suite.
Adds the Starjack Free Companies: a neutral, hostile-capable spacefaring faction that lives entirely in orbit.
Unlike Odyssey's Traders Guild, the Free Companies are a real power - they can send military aid, they generate quest sites, and they field a full combat ladder. You can ally with them, hire them against the Glitterites, or take their stations by force.
Starjack-dominant, and contained: the xenotype never leaks into planetside factions. While relations are neutral they stay off the surface entirely, so a spacer faction will not come wandering into a neolithic camp.
Requires Odyssey (orbit layer, starjack xenotype, astropolitan culture) and Biotech.
